transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Um, thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

I guess... well, I came in because my eating habits have gotten a little, um, off the rails lately? I'm usually really good about tracking my food—I'm a project manager, so I usually like keeping things very organized—but I just kind of stopped caring about it. I've been skipping real meals for days at a time, just sort of living on coffee and protein bars. 

I know that's not a good way to handle things, and I probably should have been paying better attention. I didn't even really notice it was an issue until my clothes started hanging pretty loose on me. Is... is that the kind of thing I should be telling you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you been avoiding food or limiting your eating because you're worried about gaining weight or because you feel you need to lose weight?

Oh, no, no, it's not like that at all. I really don't think I need to lose weight or anything. I mean, I know I'm probably too thin right now, honestly. It's just... I don't know, it's not about how I look. 

I just kind of... forget? Or I just don't have the appetite for it. I hope that makes sense. I don't want you to think I'm doing this on purpose to be unhealthy. Does that sound like what you were asking?
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?

Um, well... I guess I have been feeling a little down. I mean, maybe not like, severely depressed or anything, but... yeah. 

It kind of started recently at work. I'm a project manager, and I usually take a lot of pride in my work, but... one of the sponsors questioned my judgment on a project. And I know I shouldn't have let it get to me so much, it's just business, right? But... I don't know, it was like the bottom just dropped out. I ended up just sitting in my apartment feeling really... hollow, I guess? And ashamed. I even found myself crying over some emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. 

I'm sorry, I know that sounds like such an overreaction. I shouldn't be letting work get to me like that. Do you think that's normal, to get that upset over something professional? I just want to make sure I'm not, you know, making a mountain out of a molehill.
Have you noticed that most days, you feel down or lose interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day?

Um, yeah... I guess it has been pretty much every day since that happened. Like, most of the day, really. 

Ever since that sponsor questioned my judgment... I don't know, it just really hit me hard. I've just been sitting in my apartment for hours, feeling so... hollow. And just really ashamed of myself. I've been crying over these standard work emails that, you know, normally I would just fire off a reply to and not even think twice about. 

I know I shouldn't be letting it consume my whole day like this. I really am trying to snap out of it, I promise. It's just... it's been hard to shake. I hope it's okay that I'm being this honest with you about it. I don't want to sound like I'm just whining. Is it helpful for you to know that it's been happening every day?
Have you been feeling fatigued or like you don’t have much energy lately, even if you’re not physically active?

Um, energy? No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm definitely a little tired, but who isn't, right? I'm sure it's just normal tiredness from work and everything. 

I haven't been feeling, like, completely drained or fatigued or anything extreme like that. I'm still trying to keep up with things as best I can. I don't want you to think I'm just laying around all day doing absolutely nothing. I really am trying. Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering your questions the right way.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

Um, well... I mean, I guess I've been a little hard on myself about the whole project thing. But I think anyone would be, right? 

I wouldn't say I feel like I'm not good enough in general. I mean, I know I'm usually really good at my job. It's just... I guess I've been replaying that meeting in my head a lot, wondering what I could have done differently to not have my judgment questioned like that. I feel like I let my team down a bit, maybe? But I'm not, like, completely consumed by guilt or anything terrible like that. I'm just trying to take responsibility for my part in it. 

I hope that's the right way to look at it? I just want to make sure I'm giving you an accurate picture without making it sound worse than it is. I'm really trying to keep a balanced perspective on it all.
Have you found it harder to focus, make decisions, or think clearly lately?

Um, focusing? I mean... maybe a little bit? But I think that's just because I've had so much on my plate recently, you know? 

I wouldn't say I can't think clearly or anything. I'm still getting my work done. It might take me a tiny bit longer to, like, decide how to word an email or organize my schedule for the week, but I always get there. I just want to make sure I'm doing everything perfectly so nobody has a reason to doubt me again. 

So, I don't think it's a real problem with my focus... just me trying to be extra careful. I hope that makes sense? I really don't want it to sound like I'm slipping at my job, because I'm definitely still handling my responsibilities. Is it okay that I'm just being a bit more cautious right now?
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your appetite or experienced any unintentional weight loss recently?

Um, my appetite? Well... I guess maybe it's been a little, um, off track lately? But I really think that's just because I've been so focused on work and making sure everything is perfect, you know? 

I mean, I did kind of stop caring about my usual food tracking... which I know I probably shouldn't have let slide. And I guess I might have skipped sitting down for real meals for a few days. I've mostly just been living on coffee and protein bars. But that's just because it's so much more efficient when you're busy, right? 

I did notice that my clothes started hanging a little loose before I even really realized what was happening... but it's not like I'm intentionally trying to lose weight or anything extreme like that. I'm still getting some calories in with the bars. I just hope you don't think I'm completely neglecting my health. I'm really trying my best to manage everything. It's pretty normal to just grab coffee instead of a full meal when you're under a lot of pressure, isn't it?
Have you noticed that your movements have slowed down or that you can't sit still lately?

Um, my movements? No, I don't... I don't think so. I mean, I guess I've been a little restless maybe, but not where I can't sit still at all. I'm just, you know, trying to keep on top of things. 

And I definitely haven't slowed down. If anything, I'm just trying to make sure I'm moving efficiently through everything I have to do. I don't want to seem like I'm slacking or, you know, dragging my feet. I'm still keeping up with the pace at work, I promise. 

I think I'm moving pretty normally, all things considered. That's a good thing, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right idea about how I'm handling everything.
Have you had any thoughts about not wanting to live or feeling like life isn't worth living lately?

Um... thoughts about not wanting to live? I mean... I wouldn't say I actually want to, like, die or anything like that. I really don't want you to think I'm giving up or that I can't handle things. 

But... well, I guess there have been a couple of moments where it just felt like... a lot. I started having these thoughts that maybe everyone at work would just be better off if I didn't wake up one morning. Just because I've been so worried about messing up, you know? And... there was this one time, after a really stressful meeting, I guess I kind of got a little overwhelmed and I might have said out loud that I should just walk into traffic and be done with it. 

But I didn't mean it! It was just me venting, I promise. I wouldn't actually do anything like that. I'm really trying to keep a positive attitude overall. It's pretty normal to just say things you don't mean when you're under a ton of pressure, right? I just hope you don't think I'm completely losing it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Can you tell me when these feelings started and if they’ve been continuous since then?

Um... how long? Well, I guess it's been a little while now. Maybe... maybe about three months? 

It really started right after that big project crisis at work I mentioned. I just... I felt so ashamed of how things went, and then this sort of hollow feeling just kind of set in. And I guess I just haven't been able to shake it since then. I've just felt really uninterested in everything, which I know isn't like me at all. 

But I've been trying to push through it, you know? I haven't just been sitting around doing nothing for three months. I'm still showing up and trying my best. It's just that the feeling has been kind of... lingering in the background the whole time. That happens sometimes after a big setback, right? People just need a little time to bounce back? I really hope you don't think I'm just wallowing in it. I'm honestly trying to get back to normal.
Have you had trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?

Um... trouble thinking clearly? No, I don't... I don't think so. I mean, as a project manager, making decisions and keeping everything organized is basically my whole job, so I really can't afford to let that slip. And I haven't, I promise. 

I'm still able to focus on my spreadsheets and all the reports I have to do. I mean, maybe I read emails over an extra time or two just to be absolutely sure I'm not making a mistake, but my mind feels clear. I'm still sharp. I really don't want you to think my work is suffering or that I can't handle my responsibilities. 

Being able to concentrate like that, even with everything else going on... that's a really good sign, isn't it? I just want to make sure I'm doing everything I'm supposed to be doing.
